data.title: 三司绫濑 · 笑容收起来以后
data.description: 走廊终于安静下来，绫濑靠在墙边松了一口气。她把名牌握在手里，等脚步声走远才慢慢直起身。
data.action: leaning against a wall with a name badge in hand
data.promptProse: In a sparsely populated, long modern corridor after the busy event, Ayase leans tiredly against a cool, sleek wall, her eyes softly closed as she exhales in relief. She loosely grips her event name badge in one hand, while the rhythmic pattern of overhead fluorescent lights casts long, dramatic shadows along the polished floor, emphasizing the quiet solitude of her respite.
